identity.contract: Forward+ Vulkan release template; runtime glTF full exterior; generated tangents and PNG mipmaps; no compression/IBL/shadows/AA/glow; constant ambient 0.03; linear tonemap exposure 1; no LOD/occlusion; optional frustum culling; windowed 1080p vsync off; fixed frame-indexed route. Godot's BRDF, depth prepass, batching, mip chain and presentation differ from Renderer.

scope: B2-like Godot renderer reference, not isolated RenderGraph overhead or pixel parity with Renderer. CPU = setup + viewport, excludes scripts/physics/process-wide CPU; GPU = viewport observed query. Frame intervals = post-draw callback gaps, not scanout. Query observations may lag route frame numbers. Timers off/on are independent processes; differences include run variability. Godot memory monitors are not residency or allocation event counts; static_memory_bytes=0 is an unavailable release counter, not zero memory use.

decision.scope: B2-like 1080p on this machine; renderer efficiency reference, not final game acceptance
decision.budget_rounding: slowest all-geometry timed run p95 rounded upward to 0.5 ms
